licensure.disciplinary_grounds.rationale: These eight buckets cover the full distribution: application/practice fraud (misrepresentation, deceit), skill/quality failures (incompetence, negligence, substandard work), criminal history, contract-execution and financial misconduct (abandonment, non-payment, fund diversion), practicing or aiding practice without a valid license, violations of codes/building laws/rules, missing insurance/bond/workers'-comp requirements, and procedural failures (failure to respond to orders, notify board, maintain records, complete CE) that don't fit the substantive categories.

profession_specific.system_components_in.rationale: These eight buckets map cleanly onto the major mechanical subsystem categories appearing across states: heat-generating equipment, cooling/refrigeration equipment, ventilation/exhaust, duct/air-distribution components, fluid piping (hydronic, chilled water, steam, condensate), gas/fuel supply lines, controls/filters/accessories, and boilers/pressure vessels—covering every item without an oversized catch-all.
